title: 중소기업은행법제54조제6항시행에관한규정 / queue:ARTICLE:1:0:00001:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 1 (Purpose)
The purpose of this Decree is to prescribe matters necessary when the Government acquires investments made by private persons (hereinafter referred to as "private investments") under Article 54 (1) and (2) of the Industrial Bank of Korea Act pursuant to Article 54 (6) of that Act.
